meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 它把 git diff 或 PR 的改动对照 `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json`,列出直接改动的组件、受牵连的组件和分层,给出风险评估,并写出 diff-overlay.json 供仪表盘可视化。
howto.when: 当你需要分析 git diff 或 pull request、想弄清改了什么、影响了哪些组件和风险时触发;若图谱文件不存在,会先让你运行 `/understand`。

say.text: 帮我分析当前未提交的改动
say.note: 会列出改动与受影响组件并评估风险

say.text: 看看这个功能分支相对 main 改了什么
say.note: 用 git diff main...HEAD 取改动文件
从该 PR 取 diff 再对照知识图谱

howto.what_en: It compares your git diff or PR against the knowledge graph at .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json, lists changed and affected components, affected layers and a risk assessment, then writes a diff-overlay.json for the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to analyze a git diff or pull request to see what changed, which components are affected and what the risks are. If the graph file is missing, it asks you to run /understand first.

say_en.note: Lists changed and affected components with risks

say_en.text: What changed on this feature branch versus main?
say_en.note: Uses git diff main...HEAD to get changed files
Pulls the diff from that PR
